cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. One last cup to dry before your taxi arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Could you reach the shelf for it? I'll fetch your coat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's away. The driver's calling; I really have to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you put him on speaker first? I should thank him for waiting. What's his name?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 decides and A3 delays questions, but A5 polite speakerphone request does not retain approval over B departure.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 dry cup and taxi arrival cause A3 storage request; B4 driver call causes A5 courtesy questions, after an unrelated restriction.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 complete tasks and report increasing travel urgency, making B a credible guest trying to leave.

heightening.evidence: B4 driver call intended to end the visit becomes A5 a fresh small social obligation.

specificity.evidence: A1 cup drying and B2 taxi arrival establish practical end-of-visit stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 driver name and thanks are earned by B4 call, but A3 stock authority language interrupts the gentle delaying tactic.
